attribution.title: De Kandelaar, Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan 64, Amsterdam (Salvation Army corps building, 1963)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012149095 (CC0): the hall's folded south wall with its tall slit windows, the faceted east end studded with a grid of dark bosses and the red shield, the two-storey house with its window ribbon and red casements, the glazed entrance pavilion with DE KANDELAAR on its white fascia, and the low west wing with the red garage door, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
